```js
  function getState(){ return {step, playing}; }

```

```js
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var TOKEN_W = 44, TOKEN_H = 30;

  var STEPS = [
    { label: 'You compose a question in Console', node: 'user', active: ['user','console'], arrows: ['user-console'] },
    { label: 'Console Cypher-encodes the signal and sends it over rosbridge / ROS 2', node: 'ros', active: ['console','ros'], arrows: ['console-ros'] },
    { label: 'Telepathy Receptor decodes and hands the request to Interactive', node: 'receptor', active: ['receptor'], arrows: ['ros-receptor'] },
    { label: 'Interactive assembles persona, profile, time, and Memory\'s recent SQLite history', node: 'interactive', active: ['interactive','memory'], arrows: ['receptor-interactive','interactive-memory'] },
    { label: 'llama.cpp router runs Nymphaea RP and begins streaming a reply', node: 'llama', active: ['llama'], arrows: ['interactive-llama'] },
    { label: 'The reply streams back on /telepathic/response; Console decodes and restores it', node: 'user', active: ['llama','receptor','console','user'], arrows: ['llama-user'] },
    { label: 'Memory persists the completed exchange. Journey complete.', node: 'memory', active: ['memory'], arrows: ['interactive-memory'] }
  ];

  var ARROWS = [
    { id:'user-console', from:'user', to:'console' },
    { id:'console-ros', from:'console', to:'ros' },
    { id:'ros-receptor', from:'ros', to:'receptor' },
    { id:'receptor-interactive', from:'receptor', to:'interactive' },
    { id:'interactive-llama', from:'interactive', to:'llama' },
    { id:'llama-user', from:'llama', to:'user', curve:true },
    { id:'interactive-memory', from:'interactive', to:'memory' }
  ];

  var state = { step: 0, playing: false };
  var playTimer = null;
  var PLAY_INTERVAL = 2600;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  var token = document.getElementById('token');
  var flow = document.getElementById('flow');
  var arrowsSvg = document.getElementById('arrows-svg');
  var stepLabel = document.getElementById('step-label');
  var stepNum = document.getElementById('step-num');

  function centerOf(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    var fr = flow.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: r.left - fr.left + r.width / 2,
      y: r.top - fr.top + r.height / 2
    };
  }

  function nodeEl(step) { return STEPS[step].node; }
  function tokenNode(step) {
    // token sits on the primary node
    return STEPS[step].node;
  }

  function positionToken() {
    var c = centerOf(tokenNode(state.step));
    token.style.transform = 'translate(' + (c.x - TOKEN_W/2) + 'px, ' + (c.y - TOKEN_H/2) + 'px)';
  }

  function buildArrows() {
    var W = flow.clientWidth || flow.parentNode.clientWidth || 800;
    var H = flow.clientHeight || 400;
    arrowsSvg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H);
    arrowsSvg.style.width = W + 'px';
    arrowsSvg.style.height = H + 'px';
    arrowsSvg.innerHTML = '';
    ARROWS.forEach(function(a){
      var s = centerOf(a.from);
      var t = centerOf(a.to);
      var dx = t.x - s.x, dy = t.y - s.y;
      var ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
      var inset = 34;
      var sx = s.x + Math.cos(ang) * inset;
      var sy = s.y + Math.sin(ang) * inset;
      var ex = t.x - Math.cos(ang) * inset;
      var ey = t.y - Math.sin(ang) * inset;
      var g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
      g.setAttribute('class','seg');
      g.setAttribute('data-id', a.id);
      var pathD;
      if (a.curve) {
        var midx = (sx + ex)/2;
        var midy = (sy + ey)/2;
        // push control down/right
        var cpx = midx + 120;
        var cpy = midy + 40;
        pathD = 'M ' + sx + ' ' + sy + ' Q ' + cpx + ' ' + cpy + ' ' + ex + ' ' + ey;
      } else {
        pathD = 'M ' + sx + ' ' + sy + ' L ' + ex + ' ' + ey;
      }
      var path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
      path.setAttribute('d', pathD);
      path.setAttribute('class','seg-line');
      var head = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
      // arrowhead triangle
      var size = 9;
      var a1 = ang + Math.PI * 0.85;
      var a2 = ang + Math.PI * 1.15;
      var hx1 = ex + Math.cos(a1)*size;
      var hy1 = ey + Math.sin(a1)*size;
      var hx2 = ex + Math.cos(a2)*size;
      var hy2 = ey + Math.sin(a2)*size;
      head.setAttribute('d', 'M ' + ex + ' ' + ey + ' L ' + hx1 + ' ' + hy1 + ' L ' + hx2 + ' ' + hy2 + ' Z');
      head.setAttribute('class','seg-head');
      g.appendChild(path);
      g.appendChild(head);
      arrowsSvg.appendChild(g);
    });
  }

  function render() {
    // clear active
    document.querySelectorAll('.node.active').forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.seg.active').forEach(function(n){ n.classList.remove('active'); });

    var s = STEPS[state.step];
    s.active.forEach(function(id){
      document.getElementById('node-' + id).classList.add('active');
    });
    s.arrows.forEach(function(id){
      var g = document.querySelector('.seg[data-id="'+id+'"]');
      if (g) g.classList.add('active');
    });

    stepLabel.textContent = s.label;
    stepNum.textContent = state.step;

    positionToken();
    buildArrows();
  }

  function advance() {
    if (state.step >= 6) { stopPlay(); return; }
    state.step += 1;
    render();
    schedule();
  }
  function schedule() {
    if (playTimer) clearTimeout(playTimer);
    if (state.playing) {
      playTimer = setTimeout(advance, PLAY_INTERVAL);
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (state.step < 6) { state.step += 1; }
    render();
  }
  function reset() {
    stopPlay();
    state.step = 0;
    state.playing = false;
    render();
  }
  function startPlay() {
    state.playing = true;
    schedule();
  }
  function stopPlay() {
    state.playing = false;
    if (playTimer) { clearTimeout(playTimer); playTimer = null; }
  }
  function togglePlay() {
    if (state.playing) { stopPlay(); updatePlayBtn(); }
    else { startPlay(); updatePlayBtn(); }
  }

  function updatePlayBtn() {
    document.getElementById('play').textContent = state.playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play';
  }

  function getState() { return { step: state.step, playing: state.playing }; }

  // wire
  document.getElementById('next').addEventListener('click', function(){ next(); });
  document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click', function(){ reset(); });
  document.getElementById('play').addEventListener('click', function(){ togglePlay(); });

  // reposition on resize / layout change
  var ro = new ResizeObserver(function(){ render(); });
  ro.observe(flow);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ render(); });

  // init
  render();
  updatePlayBtn();

  window.AIVA_DEMO = { reset: reset, next: next, togglePlay: togglePlay, getState: getState };
})();
```
